title: bannapples!
description: This pack replaces Minecraft’s apples with bananas, giving players a fun twist on food items while keeping gameplay mechanics unchanged. It adds a playful visual change that makes survival and farming feel more unique without altering balance.
body: Bannapples! is a simple texture pack that swaps apples for bananas. That’s it—no fancy changes, no extra mechanics. It’s just a fun little twist that makes the game feel different when you’re farming, trading, or grabbing food in survival. If you’re tired of the same old apple look, this pack gives you something fresh without messing with gameplay. (also available on curseforge and planet minecraft)
